displayDepthAssessment.basis: Independent geometry/projection assessment after inspecting exact round01 source and actual rear crescent. No alternative candidate was rendered or self-approved.
displayDepthAssessment.orthographicReasoning: The plane’s yaw-cancelled world offset is (0,-d*cos35,d*sin35). This is parallel to the recorded orthographic camera ray; both camera screen axes have zero dot product with its difference. Therefore one common reduction can change depth ordering without translating/scaling/rotating the projected image or moving its physical food-root/palm contact.
displayDepthAssessment.scope: This mathematical invariance supports a narrow versioned display-depth exception, not a guarantee that any particular d yields good occlusion. Actual all-facing held/load captures must establish coherent results.
